_what: Each college's reconcile steps: after extraction, the reading procedure searches the page text again for a figure the record lacks and fills it, naming the words it came from (kb/_program_requirements_reconcile.py). Sam, 2026-10-14: "Seems like our procedure should attempt to close gaps by doing a secondary search of the catalog text to see if we can reconcile after the initial PR harvest" and "we are configuring procedures for each catalog, right. So Cabrillo's procedure might require steps that others do not." (cpl_memory sam-reconcile-pass-after-harvest-2026-10-14). A step fills a field only where the record leaves it empty, and clears one only where a step says which words the reading took it from.

_kinds.fill: pattern's min (and max) fill program.<field> when it is empty; only_without / only_with name a field that must be empty / set; skip_if_equal names a field that already holds the same figure (no double count)
_kinds.clear_minimum: a sentence giving a kind of degree's least units in the major (pattern's n) is no major total: total_units equal to n is cleared, once the record reads a degree total
_kinds.order: steps run in order: a clear runs before the fills that depend on it
_kinds.awards: 'associate': the steps read associate degrees only (a certificate's page prints its own total in the same words); 'transfer': transfer degrees only (AA-T, AS-T), for a figure such as Cal-GETC that a local degree never carries though its captured page may span the sibling transfer section; 'local': an associate degree that is no transfer degree; 'local_aa' / 'local_as': a local A.A. or A.S. only, never a transfer degree, for a local pattern that asks the two a different number of units (Las Positas's LPC-GE)
_kinds.set: a figure the page's words point to, set from the step's value where the field is empty: the catalog prints it once for every degree on its own page (source, source_words) or states a rule the record keeps as a flag (Cerritos's minimum of 60, its electives as needed)
_kinds.prefix_aliases: the college's subject prefixes as its catalog prints them, mapped to the state file's: the scorer reads a placed code the file lists only under the other prefix as that listed course (never one the file lists as printed)
_kinds.course_renumbers: courses the college renumbered after the state's file was written, the catalog's code mapped to the file's, each pair cited by the title and units both print: read wherever prefix_aliases is (the capture's coverage, the scorer, the second reader), and never where the file lists the printed code, so a pair retires once the file catches up
_kinds.course_units: a course the record lists without units takes the units the page's own course data names (the vendor call the page made as it loaded, kept by the reader as the source's course_units): never a course the reading gave units, and the note names the call
_kinds.course_hours: a course a record measured in hours lists without hours takes the top of the hours the page's own course data names (the course_units call's lecture plus lab hours, kept by the reader as the source's course_hours; the tab's noncredit total sums the tops): only in an hours record, never a course the reading gave a figure, and the note names the call
_kinds.pool_lists: several lists the reading split one choice into, pooled: where the page prints one unit figure (pattern's n) over lists each read as choose_units with no figure of their own and named with block_prefix, the lists become one choose_units block of n (name), courses in order; never one list, and never where the record's total_units names another figure; with_floors (S489) also pools lists that carry their own figures, where the page prints one total over them all: each list's figure stays in the pooled block's floors, a course listed in two of the lists counts once, and never where the floors sum past n. block_pattern (a regex on the list name) may stand in for block_prefix
_kinds.pool_areas: an area's sub-areas the reading split into blocks, under one total the page prints over the area (pattern's area and n; Hartnell's Cal-GETC 45096): the sub-area blocks block_pattern names (with {area}) become one choice of n units, each sub-area kept in floors with its rule, a course listed under two sub-areas listed once; only two or more blocks, never where the sub-areas' own printed figures sum past n
_kinds.repeat: a course or a list the page says is taken more than once (Hartnell's Music 43887): pattern's code and n give that course or alternative times n, so its units count n times; block_pattern's n, read on a choose_courses block's name the reading gave a minimum of one (or n itself, S533), makes it n enrollments from a list a student may repeat (repeats); never a figure the reading gave; a total group (Delta's "for a total of 16 units") keeps the printed sum as units_total, which the scorer reads in place of the course's units times n; n may be a word (four)
_kinds.unit_line: a requirement the page prints as a line with units and no course (Delta's Architectural Drafting 22244, "Associate Degree Math Requirement: Units 4"): pattern's label and n add a choose_units block of n with no courses, only where no block carries the label and the record's sum falls short of its printed total by exactly n
_kinds.fill_to: a list the page says fills the program to a total ("FOR A MINIMUM OF 18 UNITS", "TO COMPLETE 36 TOTAL UNITS"): block_pattern's n on a block's name gives fills_to, and the scorer reads neither end of the program's sum below it; range_pattern's n and m on a choose_courses block's name ("COMPLETE 3-4 COURSES") give the count's top as maximum where the reading kept n as its minimum (Los Angeles Valley, S534)
_kinds.or_units: an alternative the page prints as its own 'or CODE' row with no units (CourseLeaf's course list) takes its parent's units, the group's figure the page's total counts once: never an alternative the reading gave units, never a parent without them (Monterey Peninsula, S535); parent_from_block (S590) first gives a block of one course and its alternatives, read 'all' with one stated figure, that figure where the course has none (the heading line carries it: 'Select one of the following: 2 · WORK 96 · or WORK 99')
_kinds.and_units: a course the page prints joined to the row above by '&' (CourseLeaf's 'CSIS 50 · & 50L ... 3'), which the reading listed as its own entry with no units, takes 0: the row's figure is the pair's and the page's total counts it once; only where the page prints the two codes joined, the course before it carries a figure, and never a course the reading gave units (Monterey Peninsula, S536)
_kinds.semester_sum: a program laid out by semester with no printed total (Sam, Open Asks Sheet 180 card 2, 2026-11-10: count): where every block named by block_pattern is rule all and its courses add to the subtotal it prints, total_units takes the sum of the subtotals and the record carries total_units_summed; never where the record holds a total, a semester does not add up, or another block asks for units
_kinds.packed_codes: true where the college's catalog packs its course codes (De Anza's eLumen feed: C DD010G for C D 10G): the scorer reads a filed record's packed code as the listed course it names, only on the campus letter D and only when the state's file lists that course

Orange Coast College.why: Orange Coast's degree pages print their totals on the REQUIREMENTS tab, which the reading took the major from and often left the rest of (S395: 41 associate-degree records named the degree total and the OCC AS GE pattern but no units for it). College page read 38752570705 (Management and Leadership Studies A.S., 03961, and Accounting A.S.) reads the tab's textContent: "Total Major Units36 - 37 OCC AS General Education 1,2up to 21 Transferable electives as needed to satisfy unit requirementsvaries Total Minimum Degree Units - OCC AS GE60", footnote 1 "Some program major units may also meet GE requirements" and footnote 2 "Cal-GETC pattern (up to 34 units) may be substituted". So the 60 is a minimum and electives make it up. "Up to 21" is a maximum: a major course may also meet GE, so the step sets the GE units' max to 21 and leaves its min unstated (the scorer reads the span as 21, the most the pattern asks, and the electives make up the rest of the 60). S396 SkyJacaranda, 2026-10-16.

Monterey Peninsula College.why: Sixty-five of Monterey Peninsula's associate-degree records name the 60 and a GE pattern with no units for it (S395): 42 "MPC General Education or Cal-GETC", 23 Cal-GETC alone. A local degree page prints "Complete Competency Requirements, general education pattern (MPC General Education or Cal-GETC), and electives, if needed, for a total of 60 degree-applicable units" and no GE units (college page read 38749721270, Horticulture A.S.); a transfer degree page prints "Certified completion of the California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) pattern" (read 38843693844, Psychology AA-T). The catalog's GE page (read 38759288106) says Cal-GETC "satisfies the 34 units of lower-division general education" and lists MPC GE as eight areas (1A, 1B, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7), each "Select three units" (1A one 3-unit course), with no total. So a local degree's GE is 24 to 34: the least the MPC GE areas ask, eight times three, and Cal-GETC's 34. The 24 is a sum of the page's own figures, which the page does not print; S396 SkyJacaranda, 2026-10-16, proceeded on it and put it to Sam as a card. S535 SkyGooseberry, 2026-10-31: thirteen local degrees summed their major and the GE span past 60 (Theatre Arts 03622 51-61) and failed, because the record says electives fill the degree and the scorer bars a high end past the total. The page's 'electives, if needed, for a total of 60' makes electives fill a shortfall only, the same reading as 'a minimum of 60' (Title 5 section 55063), so the step sets degree_total_minimum. Fable advised the floor (a major whose own units push the low end past 60 would pass unseen; none of the thirteen does). Proceeded on the recommendation; reversible by deleting this step. The same run's page read (41192128530) found two more shapes. 25 records offer WORK 99, 98 or 97 as an 'or' row beside WORK 96 or AUTO 162 with no units of their own, so the state file's 0.5 for the variable-unit course carried the low end under the printed total: the or_units step gives the alternative its parent's units, as the page's total counts them. 24 transfer degrees print 'Complete Cal-GETC pattern and electives, if needed, for a total of 60 transferable units', words the Cal-GETC step keyed on 'Certified completion' missed: a second step sets 34 for transfer degrees on them. The college's steps had read associate degrees only; or_units reads every award (most of the 25 are certificates), so each degree step now names its own awards. S536 SkySugarberry, 2026-11-01: page read 41276213077 found the medical family (03635, 09978, 09979, 22059, 22083) one unit over its printed totals because the page prints 'CSIS 50 · & 50L ... 3', the lecture and its lab as one row, and the reading listed CSIS 50L on its own with no units, so the scorer priced it again from the state file. The and_units step gives a joined course 0 where the page prints the two codes joined. S590 SkyLeoTriplet, 2026-11-06: page read 42046379839 (#2809) found Global Studies AA-T 37243 failing its degree check at 55-65 against 60 while its major passed (meets, 21-31 against the printed 21-25: 'Select five courses' prices the 5-unit language courses). The transfer pages print the local degrees' words, 'electives, if needed, for a total of 60', so the floor step now reads transfer degrees too. Fable advised it: Ed. Code 66746 caps what a college may require at 60 transferable units, not what a student's own choices among listed options total; the low end (55) shows the degree is completable in 60, and the major's own check keeps its range mismatch visible. Measured on the filed records: it moves 37243 alone. Proceeded on the recommendation; reversible by deleting this step. The same read found Business - Accounting 22052's WORK group printing its 2 on the heading line ('Select one of the following: 2 · WORK 96 · or WORK 99'), so or_units had no parent figure to give; parent_from_block gives the block's figure to the course first. Measured on the filed records: it reaches 22052 at this college (11997's two such blocks already add up).

S424 SkyBuckthorn, 2026-10-19: Administrative Services II (30284) read the General Business A.S. page at title 0.0 in two captures (runs 39126711681, 39252972758). San Joaquin Delta College.why: San Joaquin Delta's reconcile (run 39116289105) read 28 associate degrees that pass their major total as failing the degree total under record shape 6: an 18-unit major and general education 27-34 against 60, or a 59.5-unit major past the 77.5 printed. Every degree page prints "Minimum Major Units Required: N", the general education patterns ("San Joaquin Delta College Associate Degree General Education Pattern Units: 27", "Cal-GETC ... Units: 34"), "Students are advised to double-count courses in the major to also satisfy general education when possible ... the units will only be counted once in computing the total number of units for the degree" and "Minimum Degree Units Required: 60" (college-page-read 39122473643: Engineering Computer-Aided Drafting A.S., Modern Policing A.S., Nursing R.N. A.S., Electron Microscopy A.S.). The degree total is a floor: units short of it come from courses the student chooses, and a sum past it double-counts. The major total is right as read, so no step clears it. A step setting electives_fill_degree from the same words (S415, reconcile 39122702830) turned 15 records whose pages name no electives to failing under the scorer's electives check; the scorer now reads a floor alone as letting units the student chooses make up a short sum, so the step was dropped. S422 SkyWillow, 2026-10-19: the Jev sitting of run 39206690775's verdicts (kb/jev_harvest_verdicts/san_joaquin_delta.json) read 29 of 35 unequal records as one shape: every program page prints its total as a floor ("Minimum Units Required: N" on a certificate, "Minimum Major Units Required: N" on a degree) and the record's sum is a range whose low end equals it (a one-unit alternative such as ENGL C1000E 4 beside ENGL C1000 3, a block printed as a range, a variable-unit course). The third step marks the program total a floor on every award, and the scorer passes a sum whose low end meets it. The college-wide awards filter moved onto the two degree-total steps. Its catalog prints five subjects under another prefix than the state's file keeps (ANTH 2L for ANTHR 2L, ENGL 35 for ENG 35, ARTH 2 for ART 2, COMM 7 for COM ST 7; same number and title, the readers' notes on 18815, 31692, 32341, 32913, 37638 and 40824), so prefix_aliases names them for the scorer, which renames a placed code only where the file lists it under the other prefix and not as printed. S500 SkyBlackberry, 2026-10-27: Architectural Drafting 22244 lists courses summing 19 under "Complete 23 units" beside "Associate Degree Math Requirement: Units 4", a line with no course the reading leaves out (twice: runs 39217405432 and 40517095981). The unit_line step adds it as a block of 4 only where the sum falls short of the printed total by exactly 4; run against every filed Delta record with the line injected at 3, 4 and 5 units, it fires on 22244 alone, so the other pages that print the phrase (an area alternative, a line beside a total that leaves it out) keep their reading.
